apps.name: Sony Amp DSP
apps.subtitle: Auto USB-C to 3.5mm Line-Driver Pre-Amp & 10-Band EQ
apps.localizedDescription: Automatically detects the iPhone 16 USB-C to 3.5mm DAC adapter and engages a 32-bit floating-point +7.5dB to +12dB Pre-Amp Line-Driver Boost (0.5Vrms -> 2.0Vrms) with Apple CoreAudio Brickwall Peak Limiting, 65Hz Sony MegaBass Sub-Harmonic Exciter, 10-band Parametric EQ, and direct TrueNAS Navidrome lossless FLAC streaming.

versions.localizedDescription: v1.2.0: Added AVAudioMixerNode hardware sample-rate converter (44.1kHz / 96kHz -> 48kHz USB-C DAC) and fixed Navidrome album playback.
v1.1.0: Pre-configured for https://navidrome.nas-server.co.uk with automatic zero-config library loading on launch.

Initial release with automatic USB-C DAC detection, +12dB Line-Driver Pre-Amp, CoreAudio Peak Limiter, 10-band EQ, 6 Sony Amp presets, built-in Calibration Signal Generator, and TrueNAS Navidrome Subsonic FLAC streaming.
